methodology.derivative: Forward analytic chain/product/quotient/power rules on the parsed expression tree; reject unsupported/nondifferentiable domains.
methodology.limit: Direct evaluation only after recursive continuity-domain checks at the target; no finite-sample convergence proof. Removable singularities and one-sided/boundary domains are unsupported.
methodology.integral: Parse and validate first, then form polynomial coefficients of degree<=32; evaluate the power-rule antiderivative at both bounds. Reject all non-polynomial integrands, including narrow Gaussians.
methodology.precision: Binary64 evaluation; floating-point roundoff is not rigorously bounded. No certified numerical error estimate is emitted.
methodology.mathematics: Continuity of compositions on their open domains; analytic differentiation rules; polynomial power-rule antiderivative and Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.
methodology.excluded: No arbitrary sampled-limit proof, numerical quadrature guarantee, symbolic removable-limit solver or full canonical scope acceptance.
